mgmt_bio.text: Sandeep Bakhshi, born in 1960, is the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of ICICI Bank Ltd, India's second-largest private sector lender. He holds a mechanical engineering degree from Punjab Engineering College in Chandigarh and a postgraduate management degree from XLRI - Xavier School of Management, Jamshedpur, and has been with the ICICI group since 1986. Before taking the top job, he was MD and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance from August 2010 to June 2018, and earlier led ICICI Lombard General Insurance. The Reserve Bank of India approved his re-appointment for a further two years from October 4, 2026 to October 3, 2028.

mgmt_team_view.text: Sandeep Bakhshi became managing director and chief executive in October 2018, after Chanda Kochhar quit amid nepotism and conflict-of-interest charges and the board elevated the then chief operating officer, and public accounts frame his tenure as a repair job. Gross non-performing assets fell to roughly 1.6 percent by the second quarter of fiscal 2026 with net NPAs below 0.4 percent, while return on assets rose from under 0.5 percent to over 2 percent; provision coverage was lifted to 79.9 percent by December 2021 from 68.4 percent at his arrival. Capital has gone into digital capability and the retail franchise rather than large-scale M&A. The board approved a two-year reappointment running from October 2026 to October 2028.
